description: A sticky box is held inside the view of its scrolling ancestor by its insets, even before anything is scrolled

florui.css: .wrap { margin: 10px 0 0 10px; width: 100px; height: 60px; overflow: hidden; background-color: #223; } .parent { padding-top: 5px; height: 135px; background-color: #334; } .a { position: sticky; top: 12px; height: 10px; width: 40px; background-color: #e85; } .gap { height: 90px; } .b { position: sticky; bottom: 6px; height: 10px; width: 60px; background-color: #4c8; } .rest { height: 25px; }
